## RB-001 — 搜尋結果整理

**Problem**: Search results lack enough grouping for repeated review.
**Why**: The existing display was tuned for short one-off queries.
**Requirement**: Results can be scanned and compared without losing context.

## RB-002 — 內容審核改善

**Problem**: Reviewers cannot see why a content item needs attention.
**Why**: Moderation status and content state are split across views.
**Requirement**: Content review presents the state needed for a decision.
